related: TranslatableRichText — the same editor holding one HTML value per locale.
BlockEditor — the Markdown block editor in the same package.
tagline: A form field that edits HTML (sibling package `@godxjp/block-editor`, gh#1365): a fixed toolbar — bold, italic, strike, inline code · H1–H3, bulleted / numbered list, quote · undo, redo — over a Tiptap surface whose SCHEMA is the sanitiser. `value` / `onValueChange` carry HTML holding only p, br, h1–h3, ul, ol, li, blockquote, strong, em, s, code (`RICH_TEXT_ALLOWED_TAGS`), with one attribute in all (an integer `start` on `<ol>`); anything else in `value` or a paste is kept as its text. For content already stored as HTML; new content belongs in Markdown (BlockEditor / MarkdownEditor).
usage: DO wrap it in FormField, like any field: the label names the editable, `required` and the error reach it as `aria-required` / `aria-invalid` + `aria-errormessage`.
DO store what onValueChange returns: it is already sanitised by the schema, and render it as HTML. Sanitise again on the server if other clients can write the same column.
DO use TranslatableRichText for a per-locale `{ ja, en, vi }` map instead of wrapping Tabs around it.
DON'T pick it for NEW content: Markdown (BlockEditor, MarkdownEditor) is the kit's storage format; this exists for columns that already hold HTML.
Keyboard: each toolbar group is one tab stop with arrow keys; ⌘/Ctrl+B / I / Z / Shift+Z and the Markdown input rules (`# `, `- `, `1. `, `> `) work in the body.
useCases: Product, material or recipe description stored as HTML and rendered by a storefront
Notice or email body column that already holds HTML
